base_trade: src/rts_signals/simulate.py: Rule 0 with proportionality or Rule 1 guerilla, stop / target / time stop 16:00 New York (Friday 12:00), a bar touching both is the stop, M1 bid bars; net = gross less the recorded bar spread once (buy at entry, sell at exit); R = |entry - stop|
cost: Net of the recorded MT5 bar spread only; slippage, swap and commission are not modelled — not a trading result.
drop_is_not_failure: A DROP means no detectable edge net of spread at this sample size, not proof of none.
facts: RTS's own November 2026 spot track record (105 closed trades, 2026-11-02 .. 2026-11-26) states +151 points gross. On the broker's prices 101 trades are confirmed and 4 show a different exit; less the recorded spread at each entry it is about -214 points. This was seen before the cell was designed and decides nothing.
The base trades of the reports received before the commit (2026-11-23, -25, -27) were also seen: 8 filled. They are not forward trades.
RTS enters Rule 0 trades at 18:00 New York, the broker's daily rollover, when the spread is widest.
The Morning report's positions table is read by OCR and checked arithmetically; it is information only and never enters the cell.
By the owner's decision of 2026-11-28 today's levels are shown on the chart before any verdict, labelled unverified.
forward_trade: a filled base trade of a spot report dated after the commit date of PRE_REGISTRATION.json (Berlin label clock), received (Gmail arrival or drop-folder ingest) before its session ended; reports received later are ledgered `received late` and excluded

horizon.rule: scored once on the first 300 forward trades as soon as they exist; with fewer on 2027-06-30, recorded UNDERPOWERED — NO DECISION. Never extended.

hypothesis: the mean net R of forward base trades of RTS spot recommendations is above 0
scope: Net of the recorded spread only, not slippage, swap or commission. No verdict is a trading instruction. The family never touches another family's registry, the production models directory or config.json.
statistic: sum of net R / number of trades over the first scored trades
test: circular block bootstrap over business days keyed by report date, 5-day blocks, 10000 resamples, seed 20261202 (fx_bb.score.test_ratio, side 'greater')
verdict_rule: KEEP only if the bootstrap lower alpha-quantile of the mean net R is above 0, else DROP
